create_knowledge_base: create a new knowledge base entry with name, description, and optional access control rules
search_knowledge_bases: search knowledge bases by query text, view option, and permission filters
search_knowledge_files: search files across all knowledge bases the user has read access to
add_file_to_knowledge: add a file to a knowledge base by knowledge_id and file_id
delete_knowledge_by_id: delete a knowledge base entry by its id
